title: Korean-Style Spicy Chicken Naengmyeon
description: A spicy twist on the classic Korean cold noodle dish, featuring warm, peppery flavors and a protein-packed kick.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the naengmyeon noodles according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the gochujang, soy sauce, and brown sugar to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until thickened.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and toss with the sauce until well coated.
Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips and add to the noodles.
Garnish with thinly sliced green onions, toasted sesame seeds, and a sprinkle of black pepper.
